label: POST_HOC_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_FALSIFICATION
prohibited_actions: add or change models, ranks, lags, horizons, alphas, targets or panel membership
promote a previously failed HOLDOUT cell
choose review methods based on which preserves significance

task_a_b1.selection_rule: Use each frozen selection's already DEV-selected B1 lag_depth and alpha from PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE.json; no retuning.
metrics: challenger relative MSE improvement vs B1
challenger relative MSE improvement vs B2
median per-target relative MSE improvement vs B1

task_b_familywise.row_loss: At each frozen cell decision time, average target-cell squared-error advantage B2_loss - challenger_loss over targets for which y, B2 and challenger are all finite.
task_b_familywise.block_definition: Absolute UTC calendar hour floor(timestamp/3600), shared across all 35 cells.
task_b_familywise.observed_statistic: One-sided cluster-studentized mean loss advantage T_i = mean(d_i)/SE_i, where SE_i is the one-way UTC-hour cluster-robust standard error using hour influence S_ib - n_ib*dbar_i with finite-sample B/(B-1) correction.
task_b_familywise.null_generation: Center each cell at its observed mean. For each draw, assign independent Rademacher +/-1 multipliers to every absolute UTC-hour block in the union of all cells; the same multiplier is used by every cell sharing that absolute hour. Recombine centered hour influences and divide by the frozen observed cluster SE.
task_b_familywise.max_statistic: Maximum one-sided T_i* across all 35 frozen cells for each draw.
task_b_familywise.adjusted_p: (1 + number of max-stat draws >= observed strongest-cell T)/(draws+1).
task_b_familywise.effective_tests: Descriptive only: eigenvalue participation ratio of the 35x35 bootstrap correlation matrix of synchronized T_i* draws.
task_b_familywise.decision: Strongest US result survives familywise challenge only if adjusted one-sided p < 0.05. Failure can only downgrade.

task_c_block_sensitivity.cells: All three fixed US_2024 event cells listed in us_event_fixed_cells.
task_c_block_sensitivity.include_120_rule: Report 120-minute row only if block_rows <= n_valid_rows; otherwise report insufficient duration.
task_c_block_sensitivity.bootstrap: Moving-block bootstrap of chronological per-decision-time pooled loss advantage, 5000 draws, deterministic component seed.
task_c_block_sensitivity.stable_ci_rule: Report percentile 95% CI only when effective_block_equivalents >= 4.0; otherwise report mean and effective blocks with CI=null and status UNSTABLE_TOO_FEW_BLOCK_EQUIVALENTS.

task_e_source_target_map.model: Already fitted strongest-cell TRAIN M2 ridge only.
task_e_source_target_map.coefficient_scope: Standardized return coefficients are the primary interpretable coefficients; mask/age coefficient norms are reported separately as controls because their sign is not a price-direction relation.
task_e_source_target_map.own_history: For each target, report each own-market return coefficient by lag 0/1/2 and own-market return L2 norm.
task_e_source_target_map.cross_market: For each target, rank cross-market individual standardized-return coefficients by absolute TRAIN coefficient magnitude only and report top 3 with source market, lag, signed coefficient and grouped source return L2 norm.

task_f_temporal_concentration.block_contribution: Sum of target-cell squared-error advantage B2_loss - challenger_loss within the hour; also report valid target-cell count and pooled mean advantage.
task_f_temporal_concentration.active_block: At least one common finite target-cell loss comparison.
task_f_temporal_concentration.top_share_denominator: Sum of positive hourly loss-advantage contributions only.
task_f_temporal_concentration.remove_block_recompute: After removing selected strongest positive UTC hours, recompute challenger and B2 pooled MSE on remaining common finite target cells, then recompute relative MSE improvement.
task_f_temporal_concentration.first_second_half: Split at the absolute midpoint between first and last valid HOLDOUT decision timestamp, fixed before values are aggregated.

task_g_interpretation.cross_sectional_definition: Can forecasts rank relative target moves at a timestamp?
task_g_interpretation.time_series_definition: Can forecasts improve each target's movement forecast through time?
task_g_interpretation.rule: Interpret the original cross-sectional IC, median per-target time-series IC and sign accuracy separately; do not relabel one as the other.
